articles.title: Coinbase launches AI agent accounts that can trade and spend on your behalf
articles.snippet: "Coinbase for Agents" is a new platform that lets AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude connect to users’ Coinbase accounts to trade crypto, access data and eventually make payments and purchases autonomously.

articles.title: Banking rails are moving past the 'stablecoin winner' narrative: Sygnum
articles.snippet: Digital asset bank Sygnum says institutional clients want multiple tokenized cash instruments operating interchangeably on a single platform.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Crypto ETFs
articles.snippet: Global crypto ETFs saw significant outflows in May, but diversified exposures showed relative resilience; we explore what the data signals for long-term investors.

articles.title: U.S. House bill would erect crypto-theft task force across law enforcement agencies
articles.snippet: New legislation from a bipartisan duo would set up a multi-agency group under the U.S. attorney general to take a lead on cryptocurrency theft cases.

articles.title: SpaceX stock is coming to Solana on the same day it lists on Nasdaq
articles.snippet: The firms making that possible say eligible shares can also be converted back into tokens, creating a bridge between traditional brokerage accounts and blockchain-based markets.
